Lena (CSM): Quick thread for Orbit onboarding. They reported repeated 429s and auth failures immediately after our SDK init during their staging smoke test. Renewal meeting in 5 days so flagged as high priority.

Marek (Support Eng): Can you paste the tiny log window? Curious if it's preflight token exhaustion or auth error.

Lena (CSM): Customer sent this:```
2026-05-02T10:05:12Z WARN auth token validate failed tenant=orbit reason=ttl_mismatch client-clock=2026-05-02T10:05:10Z server-clock=2026-05-02T10:05:11Z
2026-05-02T10:05:12Z WARN rate_limiter preflight deny tenant=orbit count=87 window=1s
2026-05-02T10:05:12Z ERROR http 429 preflight_token_unavailable
```

Isabel (DevEx): ttl_mismatch + many concurrent init calls = client trying to refresh tokens immediately because token appears expired. Do they have aggressive clock sync logic or are they creating tokens client-side per widget?

Lena (CSM): They said their edge proxy rewrites session timestamps when routing between regions; also each micro-frontend calls `SDK.init()` and requests a fresh ephemeral token.

Rory (Solutions Eng): Two vectors here: clock skew causing tokens to be considered expired and parallel token fetch. Immediate customer mitigation: 1) disable client-side token generation and centralize issuance on backend; 2) implement a lenient clock-skew tolerance on client (±2s) to avoid immediate refresh; 3) add randomized splay (200-1200ms) on init.

Marek (Support Eng): For graceful handling we recommended this snippet to Orbit:```js
// accept small clock skew before refresh
function shouldRefresh(tokenExpiry, serverNow){
  const skewToleranceMs = 2000; // 2s
  return (tokenExpiry - serverNow) < skewToleranceMs;
}
// splay before init
setTimeout(()=>SDK.init(), Math.random()*1000 + 200);
```

Lena (CSM): They asked if we can temporarily raise their preflight quota while they roll the fix. Renewal pressure so asked for ASAP.

Rory (Solutions Eng): Ops can do a short-lived bump but prefer app fix + proxy tweak. Propose bump preflight from 100/s -> 400/s for 3 hours while they validate. I'll pair with oncall monitoring.

ops-bot: CR-8209 opened: preflight quota bump for tenant=orbit 100->400/s, window 2026-05-02T11:00:00Z to 2026-05-02T14:00:00Z. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Isabel (DevEx): I'll add an onboarding doc note: "If you see immediate token refresh loops, check for clock skew at edge proxies and avoid per-widget token fetch. Consider ±2s clock-tolerance and single-token-per-session patterns." Adding a short code example and a postMessage example for iframes.

Lena (CSM): I'll tell Orbit the plan: client change + short quota bump. Asking them to validate by 13:30 UTC. Will update this thread with results so we can close CR-8209.

Marek (Support Eng): Thanks 75; please ping me when they validate so we can revert CR if not needed.

Lena (CSM): Will do.
